name: LEIA Voice Mode
description: You can talk to the LEIA with your own voice! Close the instructions, start speaking and the LEIA answers aloud, which is handy while your hands are on the keyboard. Try the Python loops tutor in voice mode!

name: LEIA Programming Lesson
description: Some LEIAs can teach you how to code, from JavaScript to Python and beyond. They can run tests to check your solution and help you improve. You can even interact with them using your voice!

name: LEIA Requirements Elicitation
description: A LEIA can play the client of a software project. Interview them to discover the requirements, draw your model on the platform and get it graded automatically, with feedback on what is missing.

name: LEIA Game Mode
description: You can play games with the LEIA! In the secret word game, Timmy thinks of a word and you guess it by asking questions he can only answer with yes or no.
